summary: Alector filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering of up to $125 million through TD Cowen as agent. The stock closed at $2.57/share on May 6, 2026. This is a routine equity shelf takedown using an existing shelf registration statement, not a special situation. No merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved. The filing solely describes the mechanics of potential periodic sales under an ATM agreement with a 3% commission.
